translations.title: 🌍 Help Translate Arc Raiders Bot
translations.description: Want to see this bot in your language? We'd love your help! Contributing a translation is easy and doesn't require any coding knowledge.
translations.steps:
1. Visit our GitHub repository
2. Download the English template file ([`en.json`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zfael/arc-raiders-discord-bot/refs/heads/feature/translation-support/src/locales/en.json))
3. Translate all the text into your language
4. Submit your translation via GitHub or Discord

🔗 **GitHub:** https://github.com/zfael/arc-raiders-discord-bot/issues/new
translations.sections:
• **Command descriptions** — What users see when typing commands
• **Bot responses** — Messages the bot sends
• **Map information** — Location names, event names, buttons
• **Error messages** — When something goes wrong
translations.rules:
• Keep text inside `{{brackets}}` exactly as-is — these are placeholders
• Don't change any of the key names, only the text values
• Keep the same file structure as the English version
• Command descriptions must be under 100 characters
translations.footer: Thank you for helping make this bot accessible to more players! 💙
